changes: Export Graph window: a preview of the page, PNG, PDF, SVG or EMF, the PNG resolution, a transparent background and where to save.
A redesigned Nonlinear Fit dialog: function, data, parameters and a live preview side by side; several datasets with their own X ranges; fix, share or bound parameters.
A redesigned Plot Setup: sheets by folder and workbook, a role for each column, and a preview of the graph.
Import Excel and LibreOffice files (.xlsx, .xls, .xlsb, .ods) as well as text files.
Rescale X or Y alone, and Clip data to frame for symbols, error bars and labels.
A new Insert tab on the ribbon, and a new worksheet header with long names and units.
For AI assistants (MCP): data_import reads a file by its path; fit_multi takes bounds, X ranges and error weights.
